stem_book: If x = log_(2a)(bcd/2), y = log_(3b)(acd/3), z = log_(4c)(abd/4) and w = log_(5d)(abc/5) and 1/(x + 1) + 1/(y + 1) + 1/(z + 1) + 1/(w + 1) = log_(abcd) N + 1, the value of N is (a) 40 (b) 80 (c) 120 (d) 160
work: x + 1 = log_(2a)(abcd) → 1/(x+1) = log_(abcd)(2a); sum = log_(abcd)(120abcd) = log_(abcd)120 + 1 → N = 120
